papers.title: Patterns and determinants of the glomalin-related soil protein accrual at rock-soil interfaces across two lithologies in karst forests, Southwest China
papers.recommendationReason: 重点体现导师方向与国家战略；命中“soil organic carbon、restoration、restoration”等信号。

essence.problem: Abstract Glomalin-related soil protein (GRSP) is a complex microbial-derived glycoprotein mixture that acts as an essential bio-glue stabilizing organic carbon (C) pools and driving soil aggregation and C sequestration.
essence.design: Random forest modeling confirmed microbial biomass as the key driver of GRSP accumulation, followed by mineral protection, microbial diversity, labile N, and ecoenzymatic stoichiometry.
essence.innovation: Structural equation modeling revealed that lithology and rock-soil interface facilitated GRSP formation and stabilization by enhancing N availability, mineral protection, microbial diversity, and biomass.
essence.transferableIdeas: 可借鉴其random forest、structural equation model设计。可将核心变量与土壤碳形成、稳定或通量过程建立联系。可迁移其建模、预测或不确定性分析框架。

papers.title: Evolution of competitive and defense plasticity explains the success of an invasive plant Phytolacca americana
papers.recommendationReason: 主题信号较弱，因期刊范围、时效性或方法价值进入候选，建议结合摘要判断。

essence.problem: Abstract The evolution of increased competitive ability (EICA) hypothesis posits that invasive species in their introduced ranges exhibit reduced defense but enhanced growth and competitive ability.
essence.design: To address these gaps, we conducted a common garden experiment using 10 populations of Phytolacca americana from its introduced (China) and native (North America) ranges to assess trait differences and phenotypic plasticity in response to intraspecific and interspecific competition and pathogen attack.
essence.innovation: Our results revealed that, compared to native populations, introduced ones prioritized reproductive allocation over total biomass and exhibited enhanced competitive tolerance rather than suppression.
essence.transferableIdeas: 可借鉴其common garden设计。可迁移其建模、预测或不确定性分析框架。
